body:
1. You can indeed do that, but for a page that's not the first page you'll be off by one hit then. I recommend you design a UI that doesn't change the number of hits requested per page if you're not using composition. You can't combine offset and length with page/hitsPerPage which InstantSearch uses. What you can do however is "translate" the page into an offset inside a search client interceptor
2. the other repository is an option, but because it's infinite hits it won't have your issue of needing to distinguish pages with injections and pages without

What you can probably do, to be able to use composition, is to put those banners as records in the index and ensure they are filtered out for the normal results. I'm not on that team so I don't know the exact features, but you can contact your CSM to get in touch with them.
